prompt: Write a three-sentence story about a shoemaker who finds an unfamiliar coin. Use at most 45 words.
baseline: The old shoemaker brushed dust from his workbench and spotted a strange, glowing coin he had never seen before. He picked it up, feeling a sudden warmth that made his heart race with unexplained excitement. That night, the coin vanished, leaving behind only a single, perfectly stitched shoe that fit his own foot.
steered: Elias, the master shoemaker, paused his work as a strange, glowing coin drifted toward him. The magnetic field beneath his bench caught the coin mid-air, causing it to hover with impossible stability. With a gentle hum, the coin spun rapidly before vanishing into the shadows of his workshop.
